description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeAttachmentModel used in the OrangeHRM system's API to serialize employee attachment data, including properties like id, description, filename, size, fileType, attachedBy, attachedByName, attachedTime, and attachedDate, and implements the Normalizable interface with traits for model serialization.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee attachment data within the OrangeHRM API, utilizing traits for common serializer behavior and implementing the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a PartialEmployeeAttachment entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
